text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur was amazing. She's practically
on the
same level as Opera O and Doto!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
I might have underestimated her. I think
I'll start
cheering for her from now on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Accept this praise with an open heart. It
is for
you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...For me?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to extol you as well! Your
drive and
spirit are truly magnificent,
Shakur!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I nearly mistook you for a refreshing
breeze,
coursing by! O sole mio! ♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Shakur... I, I'm so happy.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm most glad that... well, that everyone
realizes
how amazing you are!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur returns from the race
completely lost
in thought.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That's not it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's something more...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We meander after leaving the venue, in
no real
rush to get home. After some
time, she slowly
opens up to me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Basically, I thought I was weak.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to connect with someone, and I
thought
I needed approval to do that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So I wanted to be understood from the
bottom of
my heart. Hell, that might
even be what I wanted
more than
anything else.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But no matter how loudly they yelled, I
figured
they were just shrieks.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But today, it clicked. I don't want any of
that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Not likes or props—none of it!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
In fact, it makes me just as sick whether
people
are pushing me away or tryin' to
get in close.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Right now, at this point in time, I want to
be a
force so strong that no one can
look away.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A force so strong it leaves everyone
shaken and
battered.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Siiigh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You told me to be proud of myself,
remember?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You were right. The only person who can
really be
proud of you is yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: But it doesn't work if you fake it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna shut up all the loudmouths, and then I'll be proud of myself. That's the way to go about it, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I'm gonna win on the best stage out
there and
establish my total, unshakable
dominance.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I need to be so undeniably astounding
that even
the thickest idiot'll know who's
standing on top.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Now, which race has the gnarliest
lineup? Figure
it out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Going by the data and recent trends,
there's one
race where a number of the
best Umamusume
plan to compete.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Explain.
choice_data_list: This year's Tenno Sho (Autumn) looks like it'll be an exciting one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Upperclassmen like T.M. Opera O and
Meisho
Doto are a given, but recently,
another runner in
Shakur's own year has
been making strides.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. Her.
choice_data_list: I bet Agnes Digital will be in it too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital debuted the same year as
Air
Shakur and has been attracting a lot
of attention
lately.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
First she runs on dirt, then she competes
in miles,
and now she's entering the
autumn Tenno Sho?
She just does
whatever she wants, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Once you see her, you'll know. It's pretty
obvious.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Anyways, she must have her own
reasons for
competin'.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Parcae did predict that Digital would be
in the
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The current weather forecast says it'll be
pourin'
and the track'll be soft. Couldn't
ask for a worse
set of conditions. Well,
that's what'll make it
interesting, I
suppose...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...All right. That makes two generations
for me to
crush.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I like the sound of that. Sure, let's go.
Sign me up
for the autumn Tenno Sho.
